items.title: Positive dealer gamma and call-led flow argue for drift, but narrow breadth and a mixed tape withhold trend confirmation
items.note: Four surfaces disagree on conviction. SPY dealers sit in positive gamma with the flip near 769.1 beneath a 775/780 wall band and a tight front expected move of plus or minus 1.71, and unusual options flow is call-heavy and leaning bullish — 1804 contracts clear the $250k bar within 30 days, headlined by TSLA 340 calls at $67.7M on 15.4x open interest — a backdrop that favors a pinned, mean-reverting drift toward the walls rather than a directional break. Yet market-heatmap breadth is narrow at 51.05% of 134 names, below the 60% threshold, and the live SPY tape is a mixed, developing auction under algo control with VWAP 776.63. The positive-gamma, call-led structure therefore lacks breadth and tape confirmation this window, so a probe toward the 780 call wall above or the 769.1 flip below is better read as a range extreme to respect than as a trend to chase.
items.method: Cross-read the gamma dealer regime with its flip and wall levels, the options-structure walls and expected move, the options-flow lean, the market-heatmap breadth percentage against its 60% threshold, and the intraday session type and VWAP, then judge whether the positive-gamma call-led structure is confirmed or contradicted by breadth and the live tape.

items.title: US-tech and ex-US equity leadership advances while real assets broadly trail
items.note: Leadership is concentrated in equities. Sector rotation is into XLK as XLE weakens, ETF momentum is led by tech (VGT 34.68%), and the global-rotation board is topped by ex-US names EWS (Singapore, 89/100) and EWC (Canada, 75.4). The real-assets book, by contrast, is broadly soft: only industrial copper (CPER 53.3) and broad commodities (DBC 49.2) with oil (USO 43.9) hold uptrends, while gold (GLD 38.2) and silver (SLV 14.1) are mixed and both bitcoin proxies (BTC-USD 34.9, IBIT 23.8) are in downtrends. The divergence reads as a risk-on equity advance rather than a reflation or hard-asset hedge bid, so real-asset vehicles are a weak diversifier and a poor confirmation source this window.
items.method: Compare the sector rotation into and out tickers and the ETF-momentum and global-rotation leaders against the real-assets model scores and trends, flagging the sign divergence between equity leadership and hard-asset momentum.
